description: 고밀도 GPU 랙 POD 배치(랙 열·통로, CDU, 매니폴드, 버스웨이·탭오프), A* 배관·배전 경로, 전력·열 타당성 검토와 산출물(장비표, BOQ, SLD, P&ID, 아이소)을 홀별 3D 뷰와 함께 돌려줍니다. / Use for high-density GPU rack POD layout in the data hall white space: rack rows and aisles, CDU count and placement, row manifolds, busway lanes and tap-offs from the AIDC engine, MEP routing with the project router, power (busbar ampacity, EPOD transformer and UPS loading) and thermal (CDU N+1, header hydraulics, 1D TCS loop ROM) checks with pass/fail and margins, plus equipment schedule and BOQ (.xlsx), SLD and TCS/FWS P&ID (.svg), an isometric drawing per Hall (.svg) and a per-Hall isometric 3D view. Give IT MW per Hall (or total IT MW and Hall count), the GPU generation and options.

cduLocation.description: CDU type/location: row-end mechanical gallery (default), row end, in row, in rack, or plant floor.

hallItMw.description: IT MW per Hall, for example [25, 25, 32]. Alternative to halls or itLoadMw + hallCount.

halls.description: Per-Hall IT MW and, optionally, the available Hall dimensions to check.

depthM.description: Available Hall depth (m); checked against the engine Hall.

widthM.description: Available Hall width (m); checked against the engine Hall.

itLoadMw.description: Total IT MW, split evenly over hallCount.

mainRack.description: Catalog main rack id; default is the generation's catalog rack.

powerDistribution.description: busway_rpp: busway with PDU/RPP; busway_tap_off: busway tap-offs for IT and mechanical loads.

rackDensityKw.description: Main rack density kW (default: catalog value of the generation).

name: pod_feasibility
title: GPU rack POD feasibility
